objective: Test an explicit ties-to-even replacement while preserving signed zero and qualified CPU behavior.

gates.requirement: Fresh isolated operator candidate matches original finite-range Torch quantizer bytes, including signed zero, positive/negative ties, nextafter neighbors, exponent boundaries and captured raw tensors under both policies.

Composed projection/round graph and separate uninstrumented group0 candidate demonstrate intended correction on exact saved common inputs/cache; CPU remains exact; residual GPU output/cache drift is localized before any full build.
Only after local controls pass, build separate full candidate and repeat unchanged CPU/GPU numerical, partition, boundary and generation prerequisites; no retroactive tolerance change.
Actual device placement and performance are separately measured; policy labels and empty traces are not execution proof.

constraints: Original and promoted CPU artifacts/runtime stay frozen.
Do not reuse old even-round helper unchanged; its signed-zero behavior differs.
Local rounding correction does not imply all full-model GPU drift is solved.
execution_scope: Operator gate, then separate original group0 round-op replacement and controlled replay; only expand after numerical gates pass.
